Looking for an opponent in Athens?

Post the hall, the game and the time on RackUp: pool (8-Ball, 9-Ball, 10-Ball), or carom (3-cushion, 1-cushion) at halls with carom tables. See who takes the table, or ask to join a table someone else opened. The feed filters by city, and every month there is a ranking by city and hall.
